metadata.description: Update an existing property for a specified object type within a given app.
metadata.learn_more: Update an existing property for a specified object type within a given app. This operation allows you to modify the details of a property, such as its label, type, or description, to better fit your application's requirements.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app in which the property exists.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of object that the property belongs to, such as a contact or deal.

propertyName.label: Property Name
propertyName.description: The name of the property to be updated.

calculationFormula.label: Calculation Formula
calculationFormula.description: A string representing the formula used for calculating the property's value.

currencyPropertyName.label: Currency Property Name
currencyPropertyName.description: A string representing the name of the currency property associated with this property.

description.label: Description
description.description: A string providing a description of the property.

displayOrder.label: Display Order
displayOrder.description: An integer indicating the display order of the property.

fieldType.label: Field Type
fieldType.description: A string specifying the field type of the property. Valid values include 'booleancheckbox', 'calculation_equation', 'checkbox', 'date', 'file', 'html', 'number', 'phonenumber', 'radio', 'select', 'text', and 'textarea'.

formField.label: Form Field
formField.description: A boolean indicating whether the property is a form field.

groupName.label: Group Name
groupName.description: A string representing the name of the group to which the property belongs.

hasUniqueValue.label: Has Unique Value
hasUniqueValue.description: A boolean indicating whether the property has a unique value.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: A boolean indicating whether the property is hidden.

label.label: Label
label.description: A string representing the display label for the property.

numberDisplayHint.label: Number Display Hint
numberDisplayHint.description: A string providing a hint on how to display numbers. Valid values include 'unformatted', 'formatted', 'currency', 'percentage', 'duration', and 'probability'.

options.label: Options
options.description: An array of OptionInput objects representing the options available for the property.

showCurrencySymbol.label: Show Currency Symbol
showCurrencySymbol.description: A boolean indicating whether to show the currency symbol for the property.

textDisplayHint.label: Text Display Hint
textDisplayHint.description: A string providing a hint on how to display text. Valid values include 'unformatted_single_line', 'multi_line', 'email', 'phone_number', 'domain_name', 'ip_address', 'physical_address', and 'postal_code'.

type.label: Type
type.description: A string indicating the data type of the property. Valid values include 'bool', 'date', 'datetime', 'enumeration', 'number', 'phone_number', and 'string'.
